note: Hand-labelled by the developer of this tool (not independent). Labels describe what the *crawled snapshot* supports: the registration, login and administration screens were not reached by the bounded crawl, so those requirements are expected gaps here even though the live app has them. `screens` = acceptable screens, written as 'route|title-fragment'. `expect` = 'match' | 'gap'. `ambiguous` requirements are not scored (a reasonable reviewer could go either way).
snapshot: Juice Shop (demo), bounded crawl, Customer + Admin

FR-4.why: Log out lives in an account menu that the crawler does not treat as a screen

FR-11.why: Checkout steps were not crawled; Basket/Payment/Addresses are partial matches

FR-20.why: Access rule; needs the role matrix, not a screen

REQ-004.why: Registration/login were not crawled, but the Dataerasure form has a required email field, so a mapping there is defensible (noticed while inspecting the first run)

undocumented_screens.note: Screens that exist in the snapshot and that no requirement in the BRD describes (checked against the BRD text).
